rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Walked every pronoun/demonstrative/definite-noun across all 9 chunks in order. The only body change since the pin (0cea7581..HEAD) is chunk 1 line 11, 'The training runs on YOUR real work.' -> 'YOUR real work is the material.' — no referent touched, verdict unaffected. Closest-to-violating, unchanged from before: chunk 1 line 22 'The curated security skills install when you extract the bundle.' — 'the bundle' is not named anywhere earlier; the tarball is first named at chunk 4 line 45 (`ae101-content.tar.gz`) and 'the bundle' as a term first appears in chunk 5's own header (line 51), three slides later. Stays inside: this is an aside the reader need not act on at this slide, and the verb 'extract' supplies the gist (a downloaded package unpacked later) — the same forward-preview device the file already uses deliberately one clause earlier in the same sentence family ('the repo itself (picked next)', line 22) and at chunk 0 line 7 ('the repo picked', 'the curated skills installed'). No other candidate: chunk 3 line 40 'the repo you just picked' resolves to chunk 2 (sequential); chunk 6 line 66 'the candidate-bug screen' resolves to chunk 6 line 62 'the bug screen' (in-chunk); chunk 8 line 80 'The bug you picked' resolves to chunk 6's bug-screen (same-file backward, session-artifact-adjacent).

Two off-file links, both named not located: chunk 2 line 34 '[build one from zero](trainings/agentic-engineering-101/supplementary/build-a-project-from-zero.md)' names the destination in the link text itself; chunk 7 line 76 'Simon Willison, [Vibe engineering](...)' names author and title in the same sentence. Neither points at another file by position ('the opening lecture said'). The diff-region edit (line 11) sits outside both. No cross-file positional callback found anywhere in the body.

Checked all 5 sub-items across all 9 chunks, including the diff-touched line 11 ('YOUR real work is the material.'): no 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' construction; no anaphora/epistrophe triple; no self-grading superlative; no number-plus-own-retraction (the runtime/time figures sit in the maintainer block, below the cut, out of body scope); no abstraction-noun stack; no empty-leg verb triplet. rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All 8 body headings are imperative ('Bring real work', 'Bring to Module 1') or numbered phase/step labels ('1. Pick THE repo' ... '5. Pick a trivial bug and confirm Module 1 readiness') — the exercise-heading convention, matching what this file is (a task walkthrough, not a lecture). No slide here is a law/consolidation moment where the header IS the teaching, so the claim requirement never triggers. 'Pre-read before Module 1' and 'Bring to Module 1' read as the explicit NOT-violation carve-out (orientation/catalogue-style labels), not mislabelled claims.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Checked all three classes against every bullet/sentence in all 9 chunks, including the diff-touched line 11. (a) doctrine restatement — none found; prework has no prior lens/split/law to re-announce, it is pure logistics. (b) self-referential design commentary — the line-11 edit actually moves AWAY from this risk: the prior wording 'The training runs on YOUR real work.' put 'the training' in subject position (commenting on the training's own mechanism); the current 'YOUR real work is the material.' is a plain definitional topic sentence, not a remark about the curriculum's design — no sentence in the current body tells the student they are inside a pedagogy. (c) aphorism kicker — closest candidate chunk 6 line 70 '*Small steer, small trick. A minute here, another there.*'; stays inside because it is concrete to the specific AskUserQuestion tip just given (lines 66-68), not a restatement of the header or a `**The point:**`-style line. No bullet meeting the 'carries nothing' bar found.
